description:
Section 80C of the Income Tax Act of India is quite popular among taxpayers. Watch this video to know about this tax-saving section. 

1- What does section 80C offer? 
As per Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, you can claim a deduction of Rs. 1.5 Lakh from taxable income on specific investments and payments.
2- How to save without making any investment? 
You can save tax with principle repaid on home loans and premiums paid on life insurance policies. 
3- How much one can save? 
Your saving depends on your tax slab. Taxpayers who are in the highest tax bracket can save up to 30% of Rs. 1.5 Lakh i.e., 46,800.
